newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's TISA will not increase stake in CANTV.
newsitem.headline: Spain's TISA will not increase stake in CANTV.

text.p: Spain's Telefonica International (TISA) on Monday said it would not be increasing its stake in CANTV when the Venezuelan telephone company is privatised in November.

"We will not be involved in this privatisation. We have a minority shareholding in CANTV of six percent and we do not intend to increase our stake," Marcial Portela, managing director of TISA, told Reuters in an interview.
The Venezuelan government plans to sell a 40 percent stake in CANTV in mid-November, with a further nine percent to be offered to employees.
The company was partly privatized in 1991 when the government sold 40 percent of its holding to the VenWorld consortium and 11 percent to employees.
